executive_summary:
Episode 30 centers on three documentary threads tied to artifact presentations. First, the host plays Megyn Kelly's tour Q&A clip in which Megyn publicly corrects Ben Shapiro's claim that Candace had accused Erica Kirk of murder, and presents Megyn's backstage video in which Charlie Kirk is heard saying "Go Max" to Tucker Carlson prior to his Student Action Summit speech. Second, the host plays a Frank Turk interview segment identifying the previously anonymous "old man talking to a bush" pre-event as Butch Hibbs, brother of Pastor Jack Hibbs, and presents a photograph of Hibbs with Kirk taken approximately twenty minutes before the shooting. Third, the host reads directly from the Alexis Wilkins lawsuit against Elijah Schaefer, citing a September 14, 2025 Hen Mazig X post and a Schaefer response photograph as the underlying basis of the $5 million action.

The episode also introduces several unanchored investigative threads (UVU outdoor venue selection timeline, Mikey McCoy first name, TPUSA Faith / Calvary Chapel military pipeline pattern, Timpanogos vs. Utah Valley Hospital record-sharing systems, TPUSA email-tracking software claim) which are recorded as investigation target nodes rather than claims because no in-episode artifact anchors them. A Kanye West "Defcon 3" tweet is read aloud and is recorded as a standalone artifact per the read/display rule.

---

sub_items.description: Megyn Kelly Tour Q&A clip in which audience member "Joshua" asks why she looked uncomfortable during Ben Shapiro's appearance and Megyn Kelly responds that she has since learned Candace has not accused Erica Kirk of murder and has been defending her.
Dave Rubin show clip characterizing Ben Shapiro's appearance on Megyn Kelly's tour as "almost an act of bravery."

artifacts.bundle_name: Tucker Carlson Student Action Summit Backstage Bundle

sub_items.description: Tucker Carlson on-camera account describing a backstage conversation with Charlie Kirk in July prior to a speech, in which Kirk encouraged Tucker to address Israel, Iran, and Epstein material; this clip was cited by Zionists as a fabrication.

artifacts.bundle_name: Megyn Kelly Backstage "Go Max" Video Bundle

sub_items.description: Megyn Kelly released backstage phone video in which Charlie Kirk says "Go Max" to Tucker Carlson immediately before Tucker's Student Action Summit speech.
Frank Turk audio/video clip identifying the previously anonymous older man seen talking to a bush at the UVU venue before Charlie Kirk arrived as Butch Hibbs, brother of Pastor Jack Hibbs.
Photograph of Charlie Kirk, Frank Turk, and Butch Hibbs, stated to have been taken approximately 20 minutes before the shooting.
Source-supplied pre-event video of an older man standing near a bush at the UVU amphitheater during event setup, prior to Charlie Kirk's arrival.
Alexis Wilkins lawsuit filing (read aloud in episode) seeking $5 million against Elijah Schaefer and other content creators over honeypot allegations.
Hen Mazig X post dated September 14, 2025 describing the prominent role of female Mossad agents in Israeli intelligence efforts against Iran, including by seducing top officials.
Elijah Schaefer X post of a photograph of Alexis Wilkins and Kash Patel, posted in response to the Hen Mazig X post.
Kash Patel tweets defending his girlfriend Alexis Wilkins and calling her his "life partner."
Local Utah news report stating that the UVU Turning Point chapter formally requested Charlie Kirk as a speaker on July 18.

artifacts.bundle_name: Rob McCoy Christian Academy Lawsuit Reference Bundle

sub_items.description: News article / federal court record referenced (verbally) regarding Rob McCoy's lawsuit with Little Oaks Christian Academy / Christian Academy of Thousand Oaks over teacher firings.
Kanye West tweet (read aloud in episode) stating he was going "defcon 3 on some Jewish people," which the host interprets as a defensive posture reference.
